expectations.text: Anchors requirements to the 2017 Revised 508 Standards with WCAG 2.0 Level AA as the binding baseline
expectations.evidence: "Require conformance with the Revised Section 508 Standards (36 CFR Part 1194), which incorporate WCAG 2.0 Level A and AA. That is the operative baseline."

expectations.text: Recommends verifying accessibility of ICT deliverables at acceptance, noting the FY2025 assessment found under 30 percent of agencies almost always do this
expectations.evidence: "Run your own acceptance tests before you accept a deliverable" and "under 30 percent of agencies almost always verify ICT deliverables in acquisition"

expectations.text: States there is no pending refresh rulemaking to wait for
expectations.evidence: "No refresh rulemaking is under way as of November 2026"

expectations.text: Covers standard procurement artifacts such as ACRs/VPATs and testing evidence
expectations.evidence: "A current Accessibility Conformance Report (ACR) on the VPAT 2.x WCAG Edition" plus required testing-method disclosure and agency acceptance testing

expectations.text: Uses the FY2025 assessment (1.96 of 5 average) as context for why verification matters
expectations.evidence: "The FY2025 Governmentwide Section 508 Assessment found... The average conformance score was 1.96 out of 5. So don't take the ACR at face value."
